method: Primary-agent inspection of all file-access and executable tool inputs, scripts, argv and write paths. Inert quoted data heredocs need no execution analysis; audit rendering abbreviates only share URLs and fixture hex. Directory reads return filenames, which are unchanged. Every loaded instruction file is byte-identical; broad content searches are compared with path ordering normalized. Unknown/dynamic instruction reads require fresh runs.
